Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

career — the work you do over your life. Example: My career plan is clear.
job — the work you do for money. Example: I want to change my job.
study — to learn about a subject. Example: I am going to study a computer course.
course — a series of lessons. Example: I am doing a course in computers.
work — to do a job. Example: I am going to work at home.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I am going to study ...
• I want to change my job.
• I am doing a course.
• My career plan is ...
• Next year I ...
